title: The AI hub, the land, and the summit.
dek: The Philippines joined a US-led tech supply-chain pact in April. Here is what has actually been signed, what is only promised, who stands where, and how the version going around online compares with the record.

feature.band_title: Pax Silica: what's signed, what's promised, and what's going viral
feature.band_dek: A US-backed AI hub is planned for Tarlac. Trump lands in Manila Nov 16.

signed_vs_planned.text: Philippines joins Pax Silica as its 13th signatory, April 2026
1,620-hectare site named at New Clark City, Capas, Tarlac (about 4,000 acres)
US–PH framework agreement for the hub. Officials said in July it could be signed by November.
A signing during Trump's visit. The Palace declined to say.
Site development begins on about 500 of the 1,620 hectares

numbers_dek: The benefits are projections for a hub that, on officials' own timeline, starts site work in 3–5 years and takes 10–15 to finish.

numbers.claim: 190,000 (BCDA, cited by Marcos). Elsewhere BCDA says "almost 200,000."
Up to $70 billion. One report gave the peso figure as ₱4.4 billion; at about ₱63.7 per dollar it is roughly ₱4.4 trillion.
numbers.check: Peso figure misprinted in one source

numbers.claim: About 3 GW, roughly 16% of Luzon's current grid capacity
numbers.check: BCDA says major data centers sit outside the site

numbers.claim: 4.6% of the 35,300-ha Clark Freeport. Opponents say 20,000 Aeta and 15,000 farmers contest the land; BCDA says it is public land; DAR says it has received no conversion applications tied to Pax Silica.

land_bar.whole_label: Clark Freeport and Special Economic Zone

sides.line: Jobs, revenue, and a place in the global supply chain for chips and AI.
A secure supply chain for semiconductors, AI, and critical minerals.
"Land for farmers, not Pax Silica." Groups warn of land conversion and threats to food security.
Calls for scrutiny of the project before it moves ahead.
Grid strain from power demand, and the risk of economic pressure from China.

sides_pending: China's response is still being sourced. It will be added only when it can be quoted from a named outlet or official.

viral.claim: "Trump is coming to Manila to sign Pax Silica."
viral.label: Not confirmed
viral.record: Trump's attendance at the ASEAN Summit (Nov 16–18) is confirmed. A Pax Silica signing during the visit is not; the Palace declined to say. The link was made by a labor leader quoted in Bilyonaryo and by groups opposing the hub.

events.text: Philippines joins Pax Silica; State Dept announces the hub plan
BCDA: framework could be signed by November
Palace confirms Trump for the ASEAN Summit
About 1,000 march to Mendiola against Pax Silica and land grabs
